title: soroseris hookeriana subsp. handelii
intro: Soroseris hookeriana subsp. handelii, commonly known as  'Indian Salsola' or 'Saltwort', is a plant species within the family Amaranthaceae. This plant is rich in health benefits, including its potential to help lower blood pressure and improve cardiovascular health due to its diuretic properties. The therapeutic actions of Soroseris hookeriana subsp. handelii include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may aid in treating various conditions such as arthritis, diabetes, and certain types of cancer. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
